claims.statement: The workflow supports governed support triage and human handoff.
A clean synthetic trial runs locally without paid APIs or platform writes.
Seven synthetic cases exercise five supported redaction types and one safe identifier.
Unsupported or unresolved policy cases abstain and require human handoff.
Two privacy components were screened without forcing an unnecessary dependency.
A synthetic privacy requirement links implementation to regression evidence.
Exact-pattern, synthetic-data and human-authority limitations remain explicit.

boundaries: Selected exact patterns only; this is not full DLP, identity verification or a production privacy claim.
All tickets, policies and reviewer records are synthetic; no real customer adoption is claimed.
A real pilot requires authenticated reviewers, approved retention, ticketing integration, privacy review and monitored false-positive/false-negative handling.
